appInfo.description: Moodsea Gallery is a contemporary art gallery founded in 2019, dedicated to curated exhibitions that bridge Eastern and Western artistic traditions. We represent emerging and established artists, foster cultural dialogue, and offer audiences transformative experiences of warmth, renewal, and shared insight.
